tool_input.description: 验证原首页与 API 代理恢复
tool_input.command:
$homeResponse = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri 'http://127.0.0.1:8095/' -Method Get -TimeoutSec 10
$apiResponse = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri 'http://127.0.0.1:8095/api/v2.0/code' -Method Get -TimeoutSec 10
[pscustomobject]@{ homeStatus = [int]$homeResponse.StatusCode; homeType = $homeResponse.Headers['Content-Type']; apiStatus = [int]$apiResponse.StatusCode; apiType = $apiResponse.Headers['Content-Type'] } | ConvertTo-Json -Compress
